title: null, undefined, and optional access — concept map
intro: Two absence values, optional chaining, nullish coalescing, defensive guards at JSON boundaries, and how TypeScript strictNullChecks and C# NRT compare to run-time JavaScript.

conceptCards.title: null vs undefined
conceptCards.summary: undefined = unset default; null = intentional empty. typeof null is object. JSON omits undefined, keeps null.

conceptCards.title: Optional chaining
conceptCards.summary: ?. short-circuits on nullish base — property, index, or call. Does not validate shape.

conceptCards.title: ?? vs ||
conceptCards.summary: ?? only null/undefined; || any falsy. Preserves 0 and empty string.

conceptCards.title: Guard clauses
conceptCards.summary: Validate JSON.parse at boundary. ?. for optional nested only. Fail fast with typed errors.

conceptCards.title: Compile vs runtime
conceptCards.summary: TS/C# catch null at compile; JS needs runtime guards. Types erase — JSON never saw compiler.
